mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when UNRATE > 5.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when RSAFS YoY growth < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in industrial production growth above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing activity and earnings momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero during periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.3% signals labor market tightening and upward wage pressure, which reduces profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.3% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Housing Starts index above 10% signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when HOUST declines > 10% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS below 1.0% for three months signals a monetary policy lag and inflation surprise, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 1.0% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
